excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a yellow tee shirt with a unicorn image worn UNDER a white lab coat, yellow skirt and white sneakers.
excavation_context.stage: Pneumatic Scribing Fine Sediments from a Fragile Pelvis

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_6 sits at her lab workbench under focused task lighting, guiding a thin pneumatic air-scribe tool across a block of soft light gray mudstone matrix. The fine sedimentary layers flake away neatly, slowly revealing the delicate, interlocking pelvic bones and vertebrae of a nesting Nemegtomaia skeleton. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
